name: MYOCARDIUM
source:
Follow Axle in his journey of self discovery with his creator Dr. Croftwood, and experience two unique endings based on the choices you make along the way!

[From [url=https://ryartchus.itch.io/myocardium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟隨阿克塞爾，與創造他的克羅夫特伍德博士一起展開認識自我的旅程！你在途中做出的選擇，將帶你走向兩個各有特色的結局之一。

［摘自[url=https://ryartchus.itch.io/myocardium]itch.io[/url]］
